subject: Music Production
title: Kanye West and the Chipmunk Soul
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Kanye West and the Chipmunk Soul.

hook.text: In 2003, Kanye West sped up classic soul vocal samples until they sounded high-pitched and chipmunk-like.

buildup.text: He layered these pitched-up vocals over hard-hitting drums, creating a warm yet modern sound.

discovery.text: Hits like 'Through the Wire' and 'Jesus Walks' turned this chipmunk soul technique into a movement.

twist.text: The technique was dismissed by many as a gimmick, yet it revived interest in classic soul records.

climax.text: Kanye's sampling approach introduced a new generation of listeners to forgotten soul and R&B artists.

punchline.text: Speeding up old soul created a brand-new sound.

quiz.question: What was the chipmunk soul technique?
options: Speeding up classic soul samples to a higher pitch
